_style_examples: With reference to the scheme given, which of the given statements(s) about T, U, V and W is (are) correct?

Choose the correct option(s) from the following: A. Cellulose has only D-glucose units that are joined by glycosidic linkages B. Teflon is prepared by heating tetrafluoroethene in presence of a persulphate catalyst at high pressure C. Natural rubber is polyisoprene containing trans alkene units D. Nylon-6 has amide linkages

Correct option(s) for the following sequence of reactions is (are) [Reaction scheme]
(A) Q = KNO2, W = LiAlH4
(B) R = benzenamine, V = KCN
(C) Q = AgNO2, R = phenylmethanamine
(D) W = LiAlH4, V = AgCN
